Closed-loop TVC: on the nozzle-thrust bypass point (1656bc4) stable at all states with a 0.004 Hz attitude loop and 0.03 Hz sensor roll-off (gain margin x2, delay x2-3); confirmed on nozf1 (k +-15 %, mass +-10 % stable); unstable with an aft IMU (doubling 70-280 s), 3x delay or damping 0.002 at all states (slow, detectable): notch or IMU at the bending node in Phase IV. Earlier PD loop was only marginally stable (min damping 0.0006, negative at left 0.5/0); aft IMU unstable. A structural notch filter or IMU near the bending node is a design requirement. Ring spin 2x (0.133 Hz) sits on the second bending pair at left 0.5/0 (1-3 %).

decisions: WSI-D1
Structural interface at the rotor bay: hub path (capped, needs Ti) or bypass collar (closes better at left 0, heavier collar).
Recommend bypass (TD-F): the only variant that closes lambda 1.95 and f1 0.095 Hz with nozzle thrust (lead 1,283.0 t FE). It is a habitat-interface change and needs owner approval.
WSI-D2
Rail material: CFRP-HM (Track R) for the primary longerons, Al-Li frames and Ti hub/pickups.
Recommend: saves ~270-350 t structure and ~1 kt departure against Al at equal lambda; no fictional material needed.
WSI-D3
Propellant arrangement: keep T-A (stretched farm).
Recommend: T-B costs +0.8 kt for modularity; G is not feasible outside the excluded zone.
WSI-D4
Which profile sizes the ship: 0.016 c maximum (13.2 kt) or a reference profile (0.014 c: 10.5 kt; 0.012 c: 8.4 kt).
Owner choice; 0.016 c stays the maximum reference until decided.
WSI-D5
I-08: stiffen to f1 >= 0.095 Hz, or an operating rule (spin-down / balance limits in burns).
Recommend stiffness if its mass is < 5 %; else the rule.
WSI-D6
C-11: He-3 at 3.0 K, corrected density, 8 % ullage.
Recommend (after an EOS check).
WSI-D7
C-01: dedicated 2.4 t shutdown store; defense buffer stays whole.
Recommend.
WSI-D8
C-14: LOW tab growth (~350 m2) + 100 % recovery cap with one loop lost.
